claims.permitted_wording: Every tested valid non-collapsed Phase 2B/2C predictor loses to latent persistence at the first action block under the registered bounded protocol.
The tested unregularized spatial cell collapses under the registered Phase 2B protocol.

The tested models show little measured advantage from real actions under the implemented controls; the exact degree of action insensitivity is unresolved because the legacy controls contain false negatives.
The final Phase 2B pooled and regularized spatial checkpoints also lose to persistence on their own complete-valid training rows.
The tested Phase 2C EMA configuration fails the registered prediction and action gates and exhibits increasing feature scale and prediction loss.

claims.prohibited_wording: Spatial JEPA cannot learn navigation dynamics.

claims.permitted_wording: The registered-minimum Phase 2D GPU attempt did not produce a valid C2 checkpoint: C0/C1 failed persistence gates, original C2 failed numerically, and detached-control C2 stayed finite but collapsed and failed the validation gate.
claims.prohibited_wording: Phase 2D proves spatial JEPA is impossible.
limitations: detached-control C2 is an amended pilot, not the preregistered C2 result

claims.permitted_wording: The tested Phase 2E learned-slot target/state geometry pilot completed on the ROCm GPU runtime but failed the explicit validation gate by collapse, low effective rank, negative hard-negative action advantage, insufficient zero-action advantage, and a persistence ratio above 1.0.
claims.prohibited_wording: Learned slots cannot support JEPA navigation.
limitations: learned slots were used as target/state geometry, not claimed object slots

claims.permitted_wording: The tested Phase 2F sequence-level consequence-head pilot did not produce a promotable checkpoint: C2 consequence variants failed numerically before validation, and the C1 consequence-isolation variant completed but failed stability, hard-negative action, zero-action, and persistence gates.
claims.prohibited_wording: Navigation-event supervision cannot help JEPA navigation.
limitations: C2 consequence variants produced no checkpoint or JSON artifact because fail-fast gradient checks stopped them before validation
the tested consequence head was sequence-level and mean-pooled, not a dedicated affordance/dynamics state

claims.permitted_wording: The tested Phase 2G source-local action-utility head attached to predicted spatial tokens completed on the ROCm GPU runtime but failed both the utility-selection promotion threshold and the explicit latent validation gate.
claims.prohibited_wording: Action-utility supervision cannot support JEPA navigation.
limitations: the tested utility head consumed mean-pooled predicted spatial tokens, not a dedicated source-conditioned affordance state
the utility target itself still requires a source-local label and action-only baseline audit

claims.permitted_wording: The Phase 2H train/validation audit found complete utility-target coverage and non-trivial source-local utility spread; source-independent action-only priors did not explain exact validation action selection.
claims.prohibited_wording: The utility labels are fully validated for deployment.
limitations: the audit tests source-independent action priors, not learned source-conditioned utility prediction
utility labels are generator-derived supervision, not real robot outcomes

claims.permitted_wording: The tested Phase 2I source-conditioned utility ranker completed on the ROCm GPU runtime and improved exact top-1 validation utility selection over non-trainable action-only priors, but failed the promotion gate by collapsing to a global backward-first selection pattern with worse utility regret than action-only baselines. A matched trainable action-only control reached the same validation summary, so the source-conditioned concatenation model did not measurably use the source observation.
limitations: the tested source/action fusion was a concatenation ranker and did not force source-action interaction
this is an affordance/utility diagnostic, not a JEPA world model

claims.permitted_wording: The tested Phase 2J FiLM source-action utility ranker completed on the ROCm GPU runtime but produced the same validation utility summary as its matched trainable action-only FiLM control, selecting backward/backward for all 256 validation source states and failing the executable utility gate.
claims.prohibited_wording: Source-action interaction cannot support affordance learning.
limitations: the tested FiLM scorer still exposed standalone action-derived features to the utility head
this is an affordance/utility diagnostic, not a JEPA world model

claims.permitted_wording: The tested Phase 2K interaction-only source-action utility ranker completed on the ROCm GPU runtime and successfully disabled the matched action-only control's action-identity path, but the source-action model still selected backward/backward for all 256 validation source states and failed the executable utility gate.
claims.prohibited_wording: Interaction-only source-action scoring cannot support affordance learning.
limitations: the tested objective still used hard argmax utility cross-entropy
this is an affordance/utility diagnostic, not a JEPA world model

claims.permitted_wording: The tested Phase 2L soft utility-distribution objective completed on the ROCm GPU runtime and changed the exact sequence failure mode, but the source-action model still selected a backward-first action for all 256 validation source states, scored zero exact top-1 matches, and failed the executable utility gate.
claims.prohibited_wording: Soft utility objectives cannot support affordance learning.
limitations: the tested source encoder remained the small RGB CLS encoder from the utility diagnostic
this is an affordance/utility diagnostic, not a JEPA world model

claims.permitted_wording: The tested Phase 2M source-only first-primitive affordance model completed on the ROCm GPU runtime and improved primitive match over the source-independent primitive prior, but failed the executable gate by insufficient primitive match, worse utility regret than the prior, and a selected primitive distribution more collapsed than the oracle distribution.
claims.prohibited_wording: Source-only primitive affordance learning is impossible.
limitations: the tested target was a scalar max-over-continuations primitive utility, not factorized geometry supervision
this is an affordance/utility diagnostic, not a JEPA world model

claims.permitted_wording: The tested Phase 2N class-balanced hard-oracle primitive affordance objective completed on the ROCm GPU runtime and marginally improved primitive match over Phase 2M, but failed the executable gate by insufficient primitive match, worse utility regret than both Phase 2M and the primitive action-only prior, and a selected primitive distribution more collapsed than the oracle distribution.
claims.prohibited_wording: Class balancing proves source-only affordance learning cannot work.
limitations: the tested objective used hard oracle primitive labels without factorized geometry supervision
this is an affordance/utility diagnostic, not a JEPA world model

claims.permitted_wording: The Phase 2O target audit found complete train/validation coverage for the core factorized primitive-affordance targets: safety/recoverability, task gain, p05 clearance, minimum clearance, and unsafe fraction. Heading alignment is partially available and should be treated as an optional tie-breaker.
claims.prohibited_wording: The factorized affordance model is validated.
limitations: no factorized model has passed the primitive affordance gate yet

claims.permitted_wording: Stop full runs of the current image-aligned Phase 2D C2 objective, the Phase 2E learned-slot pilot, the Phase 2F sequence-level consequence-head pilot, the Phase 2G action-utility head attached to predicted spatial tokens, the Phase 2I concatenation-based utility ranker, the Phase 2J FiLM utility ranker, the Phase 2K hard-CE interaction-only ranker, the Phase 2L soft utility-objective ranker, the Phase 2M scalar first-primitive affordance head, and the Phase 2N class-balanced hard-oracle primitive affordance objective. Phase 2H supports continuing source-conditioned utility work because action-only priors do not explain exact validation action selection, but Phases 2I through 2N show that the current RGB CLS scalar utility-ranker path is not sufficient. Phase 2O establishes that core factorized geometry-derived primitive-affordance targets are available on train and validation. The next JEPA full training launch requires a bounded smoke of a redesigned structured source-local affordance/dynamics state family to pass utility, stability, action-identifiability, zero-action, and persistence gates.
